mkm.text: Karlov Manor lights up with an extravagant Orzhov fireworks display as Teysa opens her gala, where she insists that Kaya owes her the night and leads her into the courtyard crowd of Ravnica's elite.
Teysa celebrates Kaya as a hero of the Phyrexian invasion and honors the Agency, but a scream from inside the manor interrupts her just as she says she has something important to tell Kaya.

Zegana is found dead, artfully posed on coats in the cloakroom, and Alquist Proft deduces that the guild seals form a pattern, which leads him to Etrata, who flees toward the hedge maze until Kellan stops her.
Later Kaya finds Teysa dead in her private parlor with her walking stick through her chest, and a note in Phyrexian script, which Kaya pockets.
